integrity: Self-review only; no independent audit or independent certification; cited literature searches are bounded and Casnati full text was not accessed.
scientific_limitations: Only split, commutative, local four-dimensional k-algebras with Hilbert function \((1,2,1)\), and only k-linear automorphisms of elements. Complete case analysis covers every finite field; four small fields are exhaustively checked, not a proof in general.
title: Element-orbit strata of four-dimensional short local algebras over finite fields
